summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new GANOH Café Bistrô features: Prazo payment for GYM Londres, Expense management system, WhatsApp link generation, and Revenue vs Expenses chart. All 38 backend tests passed (19 existing + 19 new). Frontend UI verified with Playwright.
passed_tests: Backend: 38/38 tests passed (19 existing + 19 new feature tests)
Prazo payment option visible in GYM Londres checkout modal
Prazo tab visible in GYM Londres kitchen panel with 6 tabs (PIX, Pedidos, Vendas, Prazo, Est., Histórico)
Prazo orders can be created for both Runner and GYM Londres stores
Expenses endpoint GET /api/expenses returns expenses with categories
Expenses endpoint POST /api/expenses creates new expenses
Monthly expenses endpoint GET /api/expenses/monthly returns daily breakdown
Chart with expenses endpoint GET /api/gestor/chart/monthly-with-expenses returns revenue, expenses, profit
WhatsApp link endpoint GET /api/prazo/whatsapp-link/{customer_name} generates wa.me links
Gestor dashboard has 5 tabs: Dashboard, Gráfico, Gastos, Prazo, Cardápio
Gastos tab shows category filter buttons (9 categories)
Gastos tab shows Revenue vs Expenses chart
Gastos tab shows expense list with delete functionality
Novo Gasto button visible in Gastos tab
AI image analysis endpoint POST /api/expenses/analyze-image exists and requires auth
seed_data_creation: Test data created: TEST_Prazo_Runner, TEST_Prazo_GYM (prazo orders), TEST_Expense_Mercado, TEST_Expense_contador, TEST_Expense_fornecedor, TEST_Expense_suplementos, TEST_Expense_VT (expenses), TEST_WhatsApp_Customer, TEST_Prazo_Customer (prazo customers)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Prazo payment extended to GYM Londres (was Runner only), 2) Expense management system with AI image analysis using GPT-4o via emergentintegrations library, 3) Interactive Revenue vs Expenses chart with category filters, 4) WhatsApp link generation for debt collection. Backend has 38 passing tests. Frontend tested with Playwright for checkout flow, kitchen panel, and gestor dashboard.

prazo_gym_londres.details: Prazo (Fiado) payment option visible in GYM Londres checkout modal alongside PIX, Débito, Crédito, Dinheiro

prazo_tab_kitchen.details: Prazo tab visible in GYM Londres kitchen panel showing Total a Receber, customer list with WhatsApp and Pagar buttons

expenses_management.details: Full CRUD for expenses with categories: contador, fornecedor, mercado, suplementos, VT, Vivo, sistema, salário, outros

expenses_chart.details: Revenue vs Expenses chart in Gastos tab showing daily breakdown with green (Receita) and red (Gastos) bars

category_filters.details: 9 category filter buttons in Gastos tab with expense totals displayed

whatsapp_link.details: WhatsApp link generation endpoint returns wa.me URL with pre-filled collection message

ai_image_analysis.details: POST /api/expenses/analyze-image endpoint exists and requires authentication. Uses GPT-4o via emergentintegrations library

gestor_5_tabs.details: Gestor dashboard has 5 tabs: Dashboard, Gráfico, Gastos, Prazo, Cardápio
